captions.text: The tokenizer never saw “lowest” in training. Can it still encode it?
Start from single characters, then repeatedly apply the EARLIEST-learned merge that fits.
Look up every neighbouring pair in the merge table; “–” means no rule exists.
Lowest rank wins: rule #1 turns e + s into “es”. Merge it everywhere.
Look up the neighbouring pairs again.
Lowest rank wins: rule #2 turns es + t</w> into “est</w>”.
Look up the neighbouring pairs again.
Lowest rank wins: rule #3 turns l + o into “lo”.
Look up the neighbouring pairs again.
Lowest rank wins: rule #12 turns lo + w into “low”.
No rule applies any more: “lowest” = low + est</w>. Both pieces are in the vocabulary, so we get ids.
